name: rq6-test-home-posthoc-uner
description:
POST HOC addendum to rq6-test-home, run after the final test (29 Oct) and reported apart from
it; the final tables stay as they are. NameTag 3 multilingual in its conll tagset (control, at
this commit; rules changed after 29 Oct) and in uner, which scored better on UNER-SK dev
(nametag-tagset-dev), on the home-advantage test sets. The final model is not re-run: its
scores are those of rq6-test-home, compared by point estimate. Run on the M4 Pro CPU. No
choice depends on it: the final model was fixed on 22 Oct.
